entries.summary: This repository presents a dated comparison of Llama 3 Instruct quantization using MMLU, covering GGUF, EXL2 and Transformers-based variants with result tables and methodology notes.
entries.selection_context: Use the report to understand the author's quality-versus-model-size comparisons and experimental setup, then test the models and inference versions relevant to your hardware.
entries.limitations: The report evaluates the 70B model on only 50 questions per category, versus full MMLU for 8B, and warns that these results are not directly comparable. Its model-size accounting is not a measured VRAM requirement. The 2024 results are not current model rankings or independently reproduced benchmarks.
entries.decision: Retain the published route as a dated unranked reference when absent from the current discovery snapshot.
